pictures.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: original square picture-puzzle draft for SAL0MANder, family-friendly, one cohesive 1:1 edge-to-edge scene.
Primary request: A curious red panda standing on a mossy rock beside a small forest waterfall and clear stream.
Scene/backdrop: a tranquil lush mountain forest, a small stepped waterfall spilling over slate stones into a shallow turquoise pool, ferns, broad green leaves, rounded river pebbles and a few warm golden fallen leaves. Distinct natural shapes and readable detail across all areas of the square, with varied stone, leaf and water patterns. No big empty sky or broad unbroken flat areas.
Subject: one appealing red panda, rust-red fur, white cheek markings, dark legs, fluffy striped tail, natural four-legged anatomy, whole body and tail comfortably in frame, gently looking toward the stream. No human clothing.
Style/medium: polished original painted storybook illustration, tactile gouache-like brush texture, softly defined clean shapes, warm rust-orange animal against cool teal water and green foliage, gentle dappled daylight. Clearly illustrated AI-generated artwork, not a photograph.
Composition/framing: medium-wide scene, the red panda readable near the center, waterfall behind it, foreground stones and ferns providing varied recognizable puzzle regions. Friendly quiet sense of discovery.
Constraints: no letters, no words, no text, no logos, no watermark, no border, no puzzle grid or piece cut lines, no additional animals or people, no recognizable franchise characters. Generate exactly one square draft image.
pictures.editPrompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Input image: the provided red-panda waterfall illustration is the edit target and exact composition reference.
Primary request: Transform the painted image into convincingly photographic, naturalistic AI-generated artwork suitable for an all-ages scenic picture puzzle. Preserve the square composition, red panda pose and position, waterfall, stream, rocks, foliage and autumn leaves. Keep the whole tail and body in frame and the friendly curious expression.
Change only rendering style: replace all visible painted brushstrokes and stylized surfaces with natural individual fur strands, physically plausible wet and dry rock/moss textures, realistic translucent water ripples and whitewater, natural leaf surfaces and restrained dappled daylight. Realistic wildlife-photo visual language with readable moderate depth of field across the scene. No painterly, cartoon, oil, gouache, illustration or oversharpened HDR appearance.
Preserve recognizable differentiated detail across all nine puzzle regions, natural four-legged red-panda anatomy, one animal, calm family-friendly scene. The result is AI artwork with photographic appearance, not evidence of a real animal encounter; label that in file metadata/manifest, not in visible text.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no border, no grid or puzzle-cut lines, no added animals or people, no costume. Exactly one corrected square image.
pictures.modifications: Auto-oriented, resized within 720 pixels, encoded as WebP quality 66; no crop or scene change. 720px bounds even uncompressed RGBA for the existing Unity bridge. The unmodified master retains embedded provenance; derivative provenance is recorded here.
